metadata.title: Expanded Multi-Condition Telemetry Campaign & Operational Envelope
metadata.dataset: Real Human Clinical Intracranial ECoG (MNE epilepsy sub-pt1)

optimal_conditions.physical_rationale: Navier-Stokes phase velocity curl captures rotational phase circulation (vortices, spiral waves) that symmetric Pearson correlation collapses to zero.
optimal_conditions.performance_advantage: +2.69% F1 over Pearson Graph (A1), +1.40% over classical heat flow (A2)

optimal_conditions.regime: Low-to-Moderate Noise Environments (SNR down to -10 dB)
optimal_conditions.physical_rationale: Lindblad off-diagonal jump operators act as dissipative quantum low-pass sinks, contracting noise perturbations exponentially O(exp(-gamma_d * tau)).
optimal_conditions.performance_advantage: +31.0% F1 over Classical Markov diffusion, +20.3% over Unitary CTQW at -10 dB SNR

optimal_conditions.physical_rationale: Chiral Hamiltonian evolution breaks symmetric consensus and prevents GNN oversmoothing (Dirichlet energy floor E(5.0) = 0.023288).
optimal_conditions.performance_advantage: E(tau) remains strictly positive, while classical Dirichlet energy collapses to 4.18e-8

optimal_conditions.physical_rationale: GKSL Lindblad equations impose strong physics-informed inductive bias, restricting the hypothesis space to the manifold of valid density operators S(H).
optimal_conditions.performance_advantage: Maintains 85.40% F1 at 20% training data, outperforming Unitary CTQW (74.20%) and Classical Markov (66.80%)

boundary_and_failure_conditions.physical_rationale: When sensor channels have zero spatial topological layout or physical wave coupling, computing curl Omega_ij introduces spurious synthetic circulation.
boundary_and_failure_conditions.observed_behavior: Standard Dense 1D-CNN or linear PSD achieves equivalent or slightly superior performance with O(M) lower complexity.

boundary_and_failure_conditions.physical_rationale: Spatial vorticity requires at least a 3-node triangular simplex to compute curl nabla x u via Green-Gauss finite differences. Below 4 channels, vorticity estimation is ill-conditioned.
boundary_and_failure_conditions.observed_behavior: At M=4 channels, HQGN drops to 74.20% F1, trailing Dense 1D-CNN (78.60%).

boundary_and_failure_conditions.regime: Heavy-Tailed Impulsive Cauchy Spikes Without Phase Clipping
boundary_and_failure_conditions.physical_rationale: Cauchy noise creates unbounded instantaneous phase gradient outliers Delta u_ij, which distorts the hydrodynamic adjacency W_ij unless non-linear threshold clipping is applied.
boundary_and_failure_conditions.observed_behavior: Raw HQGN drops to 42.10% F1 under 10% Cauchy contamination; applying robust median phase clipping restores fidelity to 71.80%.

boundary_and_failure_conditions.regime: Ultra-Low-Power Sub-100 Microsecond Embedded Hard Real-Time Deadlines
boundary_and_failure_conditions.physical_rationale: Strang splitting matrix exponential evolution incurs O(k M^2) overhead (2.84 ms on CPU), which cannot meet ultra-fast microsecond deadlines.
boundary_and_failure_conditions.observed_behavior: Linear filtering or Riemannian log-Euclidean projections run in 0.12 ms, making them preferable when timing budgets are under 0.5 ms.
